spec.claim_summary: Long H1 MACD-cross entries filtered by D1 MACD uptrend with no stated exit.
spec.untestable_reason: Multi-timeframe D1 MACD filter is the heart of the strategy and cannot be expressed in the single-timeframe schema, and no exit rule is stated.
assumptions: Asset BTCUSDT assumed from page context; claim text names no asset.
Timeframe 1h is the entry timeframe; D1 is used only as a trend filter.
MACD lengths not stated; standard 12, 26, 9 would apply but no concrete rule is retained because the spec is untestable.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: D1 MACD line-above-signal trend filter and multi-timeframe alignment cannot be expressed in the single-timeframe schema; this filter is the heart of the claimed improvement so no faithful single-timeframe core remains.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: No exit rule is stated, so the claimed annual return, drawdown and Sharpe cannot be reproduced without inventing an exit.

evidence.quote: execute long entries only when the H1 MACD crosses upward.
